name: currentdt-mcp
description: Current date and time, never ambiguous about timezone. Any IANA zone, DST-correct conversion.
long_description:
Gives the assistant a clock it cannot guess wrong.

**get_current_datetime** returns the same instant from every clock at once -- ISO UTC, local time with its real offset, the IANA zone, and epoch milliseconds -- so there is never any doubt which one a value came from. Any timezone on request.

**convert_timezone** re-states a time in another zone, correct for daylight saving on the date in question, and flags the hour either side of a changeover where a guessed offset is most likely wrong.

No configuration, no network, no account. Runs entirely on your machine.
